'''Hotho Allaran''' was an obese [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who lived in [[Mos Shuuta/Legends|Mos Shuuta]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Allaran operated a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] market inside the building [[Warehouse Aurek]], and he was assisted by the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[XL-77]].

When [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Trex]] ventured to Mos Shuuta, Allaran was eager to meet with him because Trex had a reputation for seeking droids to purchase for use in his trade.
